subject: SIG evidence request — access matrix, screenshots, and session logs
messages:
From: Amelia Byrne <security@orchidhealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dan Li <procurement@orchidhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG evidence request — kickoff and item list

Hi Alex,

Thanks for agreeing to support Orchid Health's SIG review. We're starting the information collection for our security team and have a few specific asks we hope to get within the next 72 hours if possible. Please find the initial scoped items below — we can loop in additional artifacts after review.

Required items (priority order):
- Access matrix (who has access to production systems + role mappings). CSV preferred.
- IAM console screenshots showing: admin roles, 2FA enforcement page, and service account policies.
- Session/activity logs for the past 30 days (redacted where PII appears).
- On-call runbooks for incident response (PDF).
- Network diagram showing VPC peering and Egress flow (PNG/PDF).

We will treat this as confidential. If any artifacts contain customer data we will work with you on redaction steps. Also let us know if you have any contractual or export constraints for sharing these files.

Proposed timeline: initial drop by Thu 2028-04-14 EOD PT, followed by clarifying Q&A.

Thanks — Amelia
Amelia Byrne
Security Engineer, Orchid Health
security@orchidhealth.com

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>

Cc: Dan Li <procurement@orchidhealth.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Apr 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG evidence request — kickoff and item list

Amelia —

Appreciate the clear list. We can meet the timeline. Quick notes and plan: 

1) Access matrix: Dylan will export our internal access CSV (roles + last auth date). Expect minor redactions (service account tokens omitted); we'll flag any redacted cells.
2) IAM screenshots: we'll capture the three pages you asked for and bundle them in a zip.
3) Session logs: we can provide session start/stop and username/IP for the last 30 days. We need to confirm whether Orchid requires raw logs or a summarized CSV. Raw logs include internal request IDs — if you need those removed we can redact.
4) Runbooks & diagrams: PDF + PNG in the Drive folder. Network diagram is high level (no customer IPs).

Action items (for us):
- Dylan: generate access-matrix.csv and upload to shared folder (ACL: view-only, link-share to Orchid).
- Mina: capture IAM screenshots and prepare runbook PDF.
- Alex: coordinate redaction instructions and confirm HubSpot ticket for tracking.

I'll share the Drive folder link in my next message with the uploads. If you need additional attestations (SLA/retention policy excerpt), call that out and we'll include it.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Sr. Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

Thanks Alex — that plan works. A couple of clarifications from our side:

- For session logs we prefer CSV with fields: timestamp, username, action, source_ip, request_id. If you must redact request_id, please note why.
- For access matrix include a column for 'reason for access' where available (e.g., service account used for batch inference).
- We'll need the runbook that covers escalation steps and the on-call pager rotation.

Also: procurement (Dan) asked whether any of the artifacts will require a DPA amendment before we accept them into our secure review folder. Can you confirm?

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Amelia
